is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated Plasmodium falciparum infectivity to laboratory and near-field strains of Anopheles gambiae (p. 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study mentions kdr (L1014F) and ace-1 (G119S) in Table 1 for previously established laboratory strains citing published references, but does not perform or report marker genotyping on vector mosquitoes.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts, allele counts, or genotype/allele frequencies are reported for any target insecticide resistance marker.

african_field_population.evidence: The study evaluated blood samples from schoolchildren in Benin using established laboratory mosquito colonies (Kisumu, KisKdr, AcerKis, AcerKdrKis) and insectary-reared strains (ASD, ASB, TSD, TSB). No field-caught African mosquito populations were genotyped.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical cross-sectional study conducted in Ouidah, Benin (p. 3-4).

sub_country_location.evidence: Study conducted in Ouidah municipality, south-western Benin (6°21'47''N, 2°05'06''E) across nine school sites (p. 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Blood samples were collected from 5th to 28th June 2018 (p. 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: No evidence of overlapping genotype datasets.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary data not required as paper does not perform target marker genotyping.

assessment.summary: This study investigates asymptomatic Plasmodium falciparum infection rates in primary schoolchildren in Ouidah, Benin, and assesses gametocyte infectivity to laboratory and insectary-maintained Anopheles gambiae mosquito strains using direct membrane feeding assays (DMFAs). The study does not perform or report insecticide resistance marker genotyping on field-collected vector populations.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report target marker genotyping on field-caught Anopheles populations
Does not report extractable mosquito genotype data
